Profiles of ebnm fits with a normal prior

Source: R/adapter-ebnm.R
ebnm-methods.Rd

reliability_profile() of a fit of the ebnm package with a normal prior gives the profile at the standard deviation of the fitted prior.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'ebnm'
reliability_profile(x, ...)

Arguments

x

An ebnm object fitted with prior_family = "normal".

...

Must be empty.

Value

A reliability_profile object whose source is the ebnm fit.

Details

The method reads the elements data$x, data$s and fitted_g of the fit, where fitted_g must be a normal distribution (a normalmix with one component). ebnm's normal prior has its mean fixed at 0 unless the fit used mode = "estimate"; the reliabilities depend only on the standard deviation, but the site table's posterior means use the precision-weighted mean and so differ from ebnm's own when the mode was fixed. A prior of another family is not a normal model and is refused.

Examples

fit <- ebnm::ebnm(eight_schools$estimate, eight_schools$se, prior_family = "normal",
                  mode = "estimate")
reliability_profile(fit)
#> Reliability profile of 8 sites at sigma_tau = 0.00244 (ebnm normal prior)
#> 
#>   informativeness I            0.000
#>   mean reliability             0.000
#>   dispersion H                 0.0000
#>   logit variance V             0.230
#>   concentration count J_eff    6.8 of 8
#> 
#> Site reliabilities range from 0.00 to 0.00.
